scope: Independent offline visual review of all eight supplied actual-game PNGs at desktop 2K, emulated phone 320 and short viewport at 200% text. No browser, interaction, source, or database access in this review.
visibleFindings: The desktop quote clearly displays the 12-kit cost, 36-kit remainder, six-hour build, rental continuity, free close and confirmation. The phone quote shows the close action and cost; its lower actions are outside the captured frame.
The sampled desktop and phone streets show the home, door, resident and yard planters. Planters remain visible, including the side placement near the fence.

The remodel and expanded-owner captures show the named home and yard arrangement controls; the phone visitor capture shows a named home and another resident. These stills do not establish interaction or persistence behavior.
opportunities: Side-yard decorations are small and close to the fence at desktop scale; check visibility and selection as larger or more varied yard items are added.
limitations: A still cannot verify scrolling, focus, action reachability, price transactions, movement, visitor behavior, persistence, or completion of the pictured flows. The phone quote and short 200% captures show only part of their scrollable content.

The supplied inputs report three separate native tests passed using local HTTP/SSE and disposable SQL with fictional stock and a separate advanced clock; those interactions were not rerun in this review. Phone views are emulated, not physical-device checks.
Full local regression, CI, and any actual installed update remain pending.
